About

Community work, done with structure.

I lead community development, governance and stakeholder engagement across a handful of open-source and open-science initiatives in Africa — connecting researchers, practitioners and developers, and building the infrastructure that lets that work outlast any one program.

  • SSI Fellow, Software Sustainability InstituteLeading work on open and reproducible AI development practices — transparent model documentation, reproducibility standards and responsible AI workflows (2025 – Present).
  • Open Source Manager & Project Coordinator, OSPO NowLeading community development and stakeholder engagement for Data Science Without Borders (DSWB) — a cross-border Community of Practice connecting researchers, health practitioners and open-source contributors across Africa, with active partnerships in Ethiopia, Cameroon and Senegal (Sept 2024 – Present).
  • Co-Organiser & Community Lead, GDG EnuguOrganising technical programs and community initiatives for a network of 2,500+ members, and building partnerships with industry, academia and community organisations to expand access to tech education and mentorship (Aug 2023 – Present).
  • Steering Committee Member & Secretary (Elect), The Turing WaySupporting governance, organisational coordination and documentation for a global open-source, open-science initiative since June 2026.
  • Technical Content Designer, All In AfricaDesigned and delivered an inclusive open-source education curriculum, onboarding 500 participants across 34 African countries, with 100+ graduates (Sept 2023 – Jul 2024).

Process

The beauty unfolds in my process

Let me introduce you to PRESH — pulled from my own name, because everything I build carries a piece of who I am in it.

P

Partner

I start by partnering with the people closest to the problem: researchers, institutions, community members. No strategy works if it's built without the people who'll actually live with it. This is where I listen before I design anything.

R

Research

I dig into what's already there before building something new. What standards exist, what's been tried, what data or context is missing. Good work builds on what's real, not what's assumed.

E

Engage

I bring people in early through workshops, mentorship and hands-on sessions. Change doesn't stick if it's handed down — it sticks when people are part of building it.

S

Sustain

I design for what lasts, not just what launches. That means aligning with open standards, thinking about interoperability, and building systems that can survive beyond me.

H

Hand off

At the heart of all I do is access. I document everything clearly so it can be picked up, replicated and carried forward by others — because the biggest barrier to progress usually isn't ability. It's access and mentorship.
